title: Verify Framework HID→InputSnapshot adapter (ArcadeInputBridge) against GDD Annex D.1; apply stick deadzone
description: Filed from TASK-029's ratified Phase A analysis (dev-t101 inventory, orchestrator-verified; origin: TASK-023 review LOW-2 deferred items). NAMED ITEM (the trust-boundary fix): ArcadeInputBridge.UpdateSlot (Barcade/Assets/Barcade/Framework/ArcadeInputBridge.cs) reads the move action's Vector2 and passes stick.x/y directly into new InputSnapshot(...) with NO deadzone — analog noise of ±0.0001 can mint full 8-way directions downstream because InputInterpreter.ToDirection8 is sign-based (correct for digital sticks, per GDD §1.3/§3.2 the deadzone belongs at the adapter boundary, not in Core). Fix: wrap with the existing allocation-free InputSnapshot.WithDeadZone(threshold) before assigning _snapshots[i]. Suggested starting threshold ~0.15-0.2 (typical analog convention) — final value is a hardware-calibration/design call, tune on the cabinet. BROADER ITEM: verify the rest of the GDD Annex D.1 'Adaptador HID → InputSnapshot' row against §3.2 (the row was flagged 'to be verified in a later ticket' by the TASK-023 review — this is that ticket). VERIFICATION: extend the existing Barcade/Assets/Tests/PlayMode/ArcadeInputBridgeTests.cs with a deadzone case; Framework code is NOT in the fast suite, so the verification leg is Unity-gated (PlayMode run in the next human Editor window). TASK-029's AC2 records the deadzone as handled here.
acceptance_criteria: ArcadeInputBridge applies InputSnapshot.WithDeadZone (threshold serialized/tunable, default ~0.15-0.2) before snapshots reach Core; no allocation added to the per-frame path.
A PlayMode test in ArcadeInputBridgeTests pins that sub-threshold stick noise produces zero direction (and a supra-threshold input still passes through).
The GDD Annex D.1 'Adaptador HID → InputSnapshot' row is verified against §3.2 item by item, with any additional gaps recorded as ticket comments or follow-up tickets.
Unity-gate: PlayMode suite (incl. the new deadzone case) green in the next human Editor window; fast suite unaffected.
